children.game_version: Non-acrobatic rhythmic stepping game to fast music

seniors.seated_version: Seated upper-body arm and torso waves at a reduced tempo
seniors.standing_version: Supported stepping without jumps or kicks
seniors.tempo_and_range: Slowed down to 100 bpm with minimal range of motion

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Active arm movements coordinated with leg kicks at clear, regular angles
movement_profile.footwork: 6-basic and 9-basic kick-ball-change with sharp, linear kicks
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Linear progression across the competition floor or stationary placement during acrobatics
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Body wave movements used to initiate partner lifts and throws
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: No acrobatics in Youth class limited acrobatics in Juniors full free style flips in Main Class
movement_profile.partnering: Close contact during dance sequences transitioning into powerful throws, lifts, and catches
movement_profile.posture: Upright, tightly controlled core, dancing almost exclusively on the balls of the feet

signature_moves.description: A sport variation where the lady springs off the man's hands to be catapulted into a high jump or flip.
signature_moves.name: Einsteiger

signature_moves.description: An advanced high-level death drop acrobatic movement.
signature_moves.name: Todessturz

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Extremely rapid and snappy, between 176 and 208 bpm
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Unregulated acrobatics without safety protocols; landing without proper shock absorption.

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Fast-paced offbeat phrasing with deliberate stress on the 1st and 3rd beats
music_profile.sound_description: Very fast modern pop and disco tracks with a heavy 4/4 driving rhythm, synthesized basslines, and punchy percussion designed to sustain rapid athletic movement.

teaching.formation: Couples or groups (four to eight couples, or triples)
teaching.level_notes: Categories range from non-acrobatic Youth divisions to Main Class Free Style with advanced flips and throws.
teaching.rhythm: 4/4 measure with stress on the first and third beats
